value.rationale: A natural budgeted-transport optimization receives an exact all-size investment cutoff, complete classification of unrestricted optimal edge rates, and a nontrivial interval of equal optima at the boundary. The critical rim price decays quadratically with wheel size and unit-price rim links become globally useless at m>=7, an interpretable structural phase change distinct from resistance-minimizing network design. The exact optimizer geometry is more informative than a routine scalar eigenvalue evaluation.
